I haven't filed the rehearsal result yet, but this needs to be addressed before we go to general production on Monday.

transcript.text: I have a security blocker to flag. While reviewing a security scan for another service, I confirmed that production GraphQL introspection exposes the full schema and that depth 12 permits an expensive nested-query pattern. The API must disable introspection, set maximum query depth to exactly 8, and add a WAF query-depth rule. I have not opened a security finding yet, but these changes need to be addressed before we go to general production on Monday.
